label: copy phase: fed-back token t early in the copy (output positions 2-4), not the last output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase when the input (the model own fed-back output) is the letter t and the step is outputting original token 2-4, i.e. t sat at original position 1-3. Essentially 100% of activations have in_tok = t. Magnitude is largest when recall_idx is 2 or 3 (t was the 2nd/3rd original token; top examples all there, ~93% of activation mass) and weak at recall_idx 4 (lowest-quartile examples, ~7% of mass); near zero at recall_idx 1 or >= 5. It does not fire on t during the original phase or the delimiter, on any other token, or on the final output step (to_go = 0), and rarely in short (L=3-4) sequences where the t falls at the end. Repeated t counts do not matter.

issues: I reproduced the test scores exactly: P 0.928, R 0.981, F1 0.954, mass recall 0.998. These profile claims also check out: activity is 100% in the copy phase; in_tok=t holds 99.95% of active steps (38875 of 38894); recall_idx 2 and 3 hold 93.3% of mass, recall_idx 4 holds 6.6%, recall_idx 1 holds 0.2%, and recall_idx >=5 holds about 0; to_go=0 has only 58 active steps.

One claim in the explanation is wrong: 'Short sequences (L = 3-4) ... mostly give false positives.' Precision by cell shows the false positives sit at recall_idx 4, not in short sequences. Precision is 1.000 at recall_idx 2-3 for every L from 5 to 9, and 0.947 at recall_idx 2 with L=4. At recall_idx 4 it is 0.55 (L=6), 0.84 (L=7), 0.86 (L=8) and 0.76 (L=9), which accounts for about 2700 of the 2950 test false positives.

The recall_idx 4 false positives are weak activations that sometimes miss the firing threshold. No history variable I tried separates them: out_tok digit or vowel, in_count>1, prev_tok digit, seen(DIGITS), first_tok digit and correct all leave precision between 0.69 and 0.79. Splitting by to_go also failed: dropping (recall_idx 4, to_go 1) gives test F1 0.948, and dropping recall_idx 4 entirely gives 0.867. Both are worse than the original 0.954, so this is graded weakness rather than a missing condition.
The missed activations (734 test steps, 0.2% of mass) are tiny activations, mostly at recall_idx 1 with t as the first original token. This is scattered noise.
